Consultoría por encargo: automatización,: Consulting on demand: automation, BIM for public tenders, custom applications and websites, 2D and 3D experiences. Free BIM readiness check.
Consultoría · ingeniería de la informaci: Consulting · information engineering on demand · ONTOS
El producto nació de poner en orden prob: The product was born from putting real problems in order, and I keep doing that on demand: you tell me what eats your hours and I build the solution. Custom automation and AI, physical-world data with drone and photogrammetry, contract reading, websites.
Para equipos que repiten operaciones o r: For teams that repeat the same operations or check documents by hand. Automated flows, checks and tools that connect your data sources, with AI where it earns its place.
Requisitos de información, coordinación: Information requirements, coordination and control of deliverables for engineering firms and public procurement. It starts with a free BIM readiness check.
Qué exige el Plan BIM a una ingeniería m: What Spain's BIM Plan demands of a mid-sized firm ▸
Para convertir unos documentos, una cole: To turn a set of documents, a collection or a process into a tool that gets used: a PDF editor, a wardrobe app, a house in 3D from a drone flight.
Páginas para enseñar un trabajo o una ob: Sites to show your work, with whatever it takes for the owner to update them without depending on anyone. The gallery of the painter José María Casado is one of them.
Para explorar una marca, un personaje o: To explore a brand, a character or a place from the browser. A game, a figure that waves, a world to step into.
Partimos de lo que quieres que una perso: We start with what you want someone to be able to do or feel. From there, we agree on what to build.
Definimos el público, los contenidos, la: We define the audience, content, interactions and devices it needs to work on.
Probamos la dirección visual y la intera: We try out the visual direction and interaction with something concrete for you to review.
Archivos, instrucciones y comprobaciones: Files, instructions and checks. Scope, budget, timeline and maintenance are agreed for each project.
